name: What documents do I need to prepare for a cash sale and rent-back transaction?

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need to prepare for a cash sale and rent-back transaction?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for a cash sale and rent-back, you'll need standard property documents such as your deed, mortgage statements, property tax records, and any homeowner's association documents. You'll also need personal identification. This preparation ensures a smooth transaction. Our agents assist clients in compiling all necessary paperwork, providing a checklist to streamline the process, a First-Party Insight based on our experience serving communities like Pinecrest and Williams Island.
